name: adc-clipboard
description: Host clipboard parity for Claude Code inside adc devcontainers: runs the clipboard daemon the xclip shim talks to, and owns Cmd+V in Dev Container windows.

adc.clipboard.images.markdownDescription: Let containers read images from the host clipboard, and let Cmd+V in a Dev Container terminal attach a clipboard screenshot to Claude Code. The daemon enforces the **user** value; a workspace override affects only that window's Cmd+V.

enumDescriptions: Cmd+V never pastes a copied file's path.
Only files already inside the container (Explorer copies, or host paths under a workspace folder) paste as a path; nothing is transferred.
Any copied host file is transferred into the container under /tmp/adc-clipboard and pastes as that path.
adc.clipboard.files.markdownDescription: How Cmd+V in a Dev Container terminal handles a copied file. The daemon never serves file contents; this gates the gesture only.

adc.clipboard.text.markdownDescription: Let container processes read the host clipboard's text (`xclip -o`). VS Code's own text paste and `/copy` are unaffected. The daemon enforces the **user** value.
